battery.measurement_scope: Entire capture, including awake and suspend/resume overhead
battery.power_check_scope: Endpoints only; keep all external power disconnected throughout

comparison.interpretation: Similar reported power and half-second internal freeze/unfreeze activity in both environments, with matching starting thermal readings. Excessive reported power is reproduced on a tabletop; the backpack is not required for this behavior. No driver or interrupt source is identified yet.

limitations: Whole-capture energy includes 42.02 seconds outside machine_suspend; isolated steady-state power was not measured.
Actual final sample was about 25.8 seconds after lid opening rather than the requested 60 seconds, so gauge settling remains unverified.
Thermal readings are capture endpoints after resume, not continuous suspend temperatures.
Only ACPI event IRQs were traced; timers, other IRQs, and IPIs need targeted capture to identify the half-second internal activity.
Both recent high-power tests share one boot; earlier two-hour low-power measurement was on a different boot.
next_step: Trace IRQ/timer/IPI activity during s2idle and correlate the source with timekeeping unfreeze events; compare the high-power boot with the earlier low-power capture.
